title: GAND：性别模糊自然数据与对比归因资源
summary: 提出GAND基准资源，包含性别模糊的英文源句，用于分析机器翻译中上下文线索对性别翻译的影响。通过对比翻译和特征归因分析，揭示影响目标翻译中模糊指代实体性别翻译的源词。
summary_en: Introduces GAND, a benchmark of gender-ambiguous English sentences for analyzing how contextual cues influence gender in MT. Uses contrastive translations and feature attribution to identify source words affecting gender translation of ambiguous referents.
